PRODUCT_VARIANT_NAME: Customized animal samples for your research
PRODUCT_NAME: Customized animal samples for your research
DESCRIPTION:
We possess the capability to acquirea a wide range of animal samples, whether fresh or frozen, including Formalin-Fixed Paraffin-Embedded (FFPE) tissues. Our biosourcing service is not just a service; it's a personalized, meticulously tailored solution designed to meet the unique requirements of your project.

We can efficiently utilize existing collections or initiate prospective collections based on your specific needs.

Please find below an overview of the species examples that we are able to provide:

  • Rodent (mouse, rat, rabbit, guinea pig, hamster)
  • Sheep and Goat
  • Monkey/Cynomolgus (limited to blood derived products)

Note: For other species such as Dog, Pig, Chicken, Horse, Bovine, and Donkey, please be aware that we do not provide cynomolgus samples except for blood-derived products (e.g., whole blood, plasma, serum, PBMC, purified cells).

Tissue and Organ Options:

For each species, we offer a comprehensive range of tissue and organ options:

  • FFPE
  • Frozen
  • Fresh

Biofluids Beyond Boundaries:

Explore the richness of our biofluid offerings, including:

  • BAL (Bronchoalveolar Lavage)
  • Bone Marrow
  • Synovial Fluids
  • Cerebrospinal Fluids

For more in-depth information and to discuss how Clinisciences can cater specifically to your project's needs, connect with our responsive technical support team.
